model_name: Compact pediatric chest X-ray prioritization CNN
packaging: PyTorch state dictionary with shared architecture code
architecture: Four convolution blocks with global average pooling

dataset.name: PneumoniaMNIST 128
dataset.source: MedMNIST+ / Kermany et al. pediatric chest X-rays
dataset.population: Pediatric chest X-rays from the source study
dataset.source_split_note: The source study reports patient-separated training and test sets.

intended_use: Educational demonstration of ranking packaged, held-out images for earlier review.

operating_policy.name: Validation sensitivity objective
operating_policy.boundary: Every study still requires qualified interpretation.

limitations: Limited pediatric source population and clinical setting.
The model sees pixels, not symptoms, vital signs, laboratory results, or history.
Center-cropped and resized benchmark images do not reproduce a hospital imaging pipeline.
Performance has not been externally or prospectively validated.
Influence overlays describe model attention and do not prove medical reasoning.
excluded_uses: Diagnosis, clearance, treatment selection, or treatment recommendation
Use outside this packaged educational dataset
